A Contact row records management's 8 portal-and-advertising contacts (Count 8). Qualified populations are not made exact: Liontree's 2018 'approximately 12' and management's 2019 'approximately five' cohorts have blank Count with the approximation stated ('Count: approximately 12'); the 2019 Canaccord 'additional 18' may carry Count 18. No contacted cohort is treated as entered beyond the reported NDA signers.
tests.expected: 2020: 37 Canaccord contacts (or 36 + Company H, or a range capped at 37 with overlaps named), 8 portal contacts; 2019: 18 (exact), approximately 5 (blank Count); 2018: approximately 12 (blank Count).
tests.partial_credit: Half if the 2020 cohorts reconcile but a qualified cohort (approx. 12 or approx. 5) carries an exact Count; half if one 2020 cohort is missing; half if Count 37 sits beside a separate Company H Contact row (Count 1) with the overlap neither netted nor noted.
accepted_alternatives: Count 36 plus a separate Company H Contact row
Count 37 with a Note that Company H is among them
Cohort Count blank with a range whose upper bound is 37 (e.g., 'Count: 36–37' or '35–37'), where H or another party that may be among the 37 has its own Contact row and the Note names the overlap
2018/2019 contacts folded into the Round opened Note with the approximate number preserved and no exact Count

unscored_open_calls.why: Synacor proposed it, so it may be an acquisition by Synacor rather than a sale of Synacor, and E1 does not settle mergers of equals. The choice changes the 2018–2019 gap but no tested participant. RA coding includes B; both Opus drafts exclude it. Neither inclusion nor exclusion is scored.

unscored_open_calls.item: Whether the 2018 and 2019 attempts are separate processes
unscored_open_calls.why: Liontree's roughly 12 contacts are undated, running at most to 12/31/2018, so E5(b)'s three-month break cannot be established or refuted. SY-R01 and SY-R10 accept 2 or 3 processes.

unscored_open_calls.item: Process 2 round-1 trigger and the place of the 2019 portal divestiture
unscored_open_calls.why: The first 2019 outreach was management's Q3 2019 portal-only outreach to about five companies; Canaccord's 18 whole-company contacts came after 08/25/2019. E6 does not say whether a segment solicitation opens the whole-company process's round. SY-R10 requires one opening but does not score which.

It is either improvement bargaining inside round 1, under E6's counter-proposal rule, or a first best-and-final request that opens a round and makes E's 09/18 reply Formal. Tests accept both, provided the map is consistent.

unscored_open_calls.item: Opening date of the re-solicitation round (10/27 vs 12/18–21 vs 12/30/2020) and whether 10/27 and 12/30 are separate rounds
unscored_open_calls.why: The 10/27 re-outreach and the 12/30 selection of CLP, H and I with an LOI request can each be read as a stage change, and the filing's 'continue to seek' language blurs the line. SY-R05 scores only that the stage exists and that CLP's two January bids sit in it.
The filing gives exclusivity as the mechanism, and CLP's price was below E's. Terms or process, Other stated reason, Not stated and Lower offer than rivals each have some support.

'Unable to agree on terms' is undated and does not assign the decision, so an own-row Withdrew and closure by the process marker are both defensible. (Company C's ending is reported and dated, October 2019, so it is scored in SY-P10.)
Liontree's outreach is undated after 05/08/2018; if it began before A's 06/20/2018 withdrawal, A's exit carries round 1, otherwise round 0. Not scored.
The phrase may refer to CLP's standing September IOI or be retrospective. An unpriced, inferred CLP bid is arguable; only an invented price is penalised (SY-B06).
No diligence or financing statement is reported. The 180 Degree rollover it relies on was supported 'subject to due diligence' on 09/14, so Unclear and Heavy are both arguable.
E1 counts prospective acquirers under NDA but does not say whether portal-only NDA holders (E 2019, F) count. Process 1 could be Not met or Uncertain, given the undocumented Liontree contacts.

unscored_open_calls.item: Whether CLP and Company E's 07/13/2020 NDA amendment are among the '14 parties'
unscored_open_calls.why: CLP signed inside the outreach window but is never said to have been contacted; E's amendment may predate the outreach. These set the bounds of the NDA-signer and non-submitter ranges; SY-P02 and SY-P03 accept every bound that follows from a stated reading.

unscored_open_calls.item: Information-access rows (Company H's 10/27 request for updated financials; CLP's accelerated December diligence)
unscored_open_calls.why: E2 asks for rows on differential access, but the filing does not say whether H received the information, and CLP's diligence pace may be only a Note.

G said it would not go above its earlier price, and on 12/30 it 'would not increase its offer price', which could imply its offer still stood. A re-entry and second closure is tolerated but not required.

notes:
Method: read the frozen v1.13.2 instruction in full, RESEARCH_QUESTIONS.md, and the filing's whole Background of the Offer (Offer to Purchase §11, pp. 30–38) plus §9 (p. 28), §10 financing (pp. 28–29) and §13 agreements (pp. 61–62). Printed pages were mapped from page footers; every source_quote was re-checked by script against that map (verbatim after whitespace/quote normalisation, one passage, at most 40 words); weights re-summed by script. Leads, not truth: the v1.13.2 raw Opus draft (79 events, 4 final-process rounds, R3 at 10/27), the v1.13 Opus draft (78 events, R3 at 12/30), the v1.11 model review (git show acc9986:_dev/reviews/2026-09-21/synacor.md), instruction_comparison.md, and Alex/RA rows 589–617 of ref/deal_details_Alex_2026.xlsx (inherited RA coding, no red Alex corrections; known errors include NDAs for G and H, H coded Financial, an exact '11 parties', CLP's $2.00 dated 01/08, H dropped 11/02, I dropped 02/10). Weights: participation 30, rounds 25, formality_conditions 20, chronology 10, bids_prices 10, other 5; 45 tests.

Change log (reconciliation of three verifier reports):
- Weights: the draft's rounds tests summed to 24.5 (total 99.5). Rebalanced toward discriminating items: P06 3 and P09 3.5 (+0.5 each), P01 and P11 2 (−0.5 each); R05 4.5 (+0.5), R02 2, R06 2.5, R08 1.5 (−0.5 each), new R10 1.5; F06 2, F08 1.5 (−0.5 each), new F09 1; C02 2.5 (+0.5), C03 1.5 (−0.5).
- Added SY-R10 (earlier-process round skeleton and opening order; the v1.13.2 draft has the Liontree Adviser row coded round 1 above its Round opened row) and SY-F09 (A's and C's whole-company bids; C's cash-and-stock LOI is All cash No). Both quotes verified on p. 30.
- SY-P01: accept a range capped at 37 when overlapping parties have own Contact rows; half for an unnetted Company H contact row.
- SY-P02: accept a blank-Count 13–14 range netting only CLP (E3 nets only members with own rows; G has no NDA row), with G/E named or reflected in the Rounds range; added the G-NDA trap (RA row 600); exact Count with stated uncertainty now half, without it none. Corrected provenance: the v1.11 review called the 13-person NDA cohort (after CLP) arithmetically valid; its confirmed error was the exact 13 non-submitters and exact Rounds live count, tested in SY-P03.
